summary_1line: Nala defeats Pushkara, regains his kingdom, forgives him, reunites with Damayanti, and the tale ends as a moral lesson for Yudhishthira.

image_candidates.scene_text: Nala wins the final throw of dice as Pushkara stands stunned in the royal hall.
Nala embraces his defeated brother Pushkara and grants him life and a share of the kingdom.
Damayanti returns to Nala’s palace with their children as joyful citizens celebrate the restored king.
